note: The amendment provenance index. Municode prints editor and ordinance annotations inside individual charter sections. Those annotations are the fastest route backward to the ordinances and elections that produced each change. IMPORTANT: an annotation proves only that Municode attributes a change to that event. It does not establish the prior text. No entry here may be used to mark a Before vs. Now comparison VERIFIED.

status_values.CONFIRMED_STRUCTURE: Verified directly from the Municode node identifier in a URL, which encodes article and section titles.
status_values.RELAYED_UNVERIFIED: Reported to this project secondhand, not read from the source by this project. A research lead only.
status_values.OBTAINED: The annotation has been read directly from Municode and transcribed.

structure.title: Elections, Initiative, Referendum and Recall

leads.annotation_reported: Ordinance 2023-33 resulted in the repeal of the former provision concerning Council's failure to call a recall election.
leads.next_step: Highest priority lead in this file. Obtain Ordinance 2023-33 and the repealed text.
leads.note: Corroborated in one direction. Sec. 3.18 is now Reserved in the current charter, which is what a repealed section looks like in a codified document. That is consistent with the reported repeal by Ordinance 2023-33 but does not establish what the repealed text said, when it was repealed, or that voters approved it. A section can also be reserved by renumbering or by an earlier repeal.

method.goal: Reconstruct the charter backward from the current authenticated structure rather than hunting forward through decades of city records.
steps: Fetch each of the 88 section URLs individually using the node identifiers in data/charter/current.json, rather than scraping the charter page as a whole.
Export all eight current articles from Municode, including the annotation lines.
Extract every 'Ord. No.', 'Amd. of', 'approved' and 'Editor's note' string into this file.
For each annotation, obtain the named ordinance from the city ordinance archive.
For each ordinance, obtain the canvass or resolution declaring results.
Only when old text, proposition, result and current text are all present does a comparison become VERIFIED.
Municode's Compare versions control on a section may supply prior text directly. Check it before assuming the prior text is unavailable.
method.first_pass_filter: Municode states that the absence of a parenthetical history note means a provision is unchanged from the original charter. So the sections carrying history notes are the reconstruction queue, and the sections without them can be deprioritized. Treat this as a filter for effort, not as proof: it is the codifier's representation.

corrections.what_was_wrong: This project recorded Sec. 3.18 as Recall, inferred from the Municode node identifier CH_ARTIIIELINRERE_S3.18RE, reading the RE suffix as Recall.
corrections.correction: The suffix means Reserved. The table of contents shows Sec. 3.18 is Reserved. Recall is Sec. 3.13. The same suffix appears on 2.12, 7.02, 8.02, 8.03, 11.03 through 11.06 and 11.11 through 11.12, all Reserved.
corrections.lesson: A node identifier abbreviation is not a title. Structure inferred from a URL is a guess until the table of contents or the text confirms it.
